sources.title: README.md · scragnog/YuE2-GGUF at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GGUF conversions of m-a-p/YuE2-3B and m-a-p/YuE2-Vae for HOT-Step CPP, a local C++/GGML music generation engine. YuE2 is an autoregressive-planner + flow-matching music model from the M-A-P team; these files let it run through HOT-Step's GGML inference stack instead of the original PyTorch checkpoint.
